newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil stocks soar on Telebras rate hike.
newsitem.headline: Brazil stocks soar on Telebras rate hike.

text.p: Brazilian stocks soared Friday on surging Telebras shares that were boosted by government-mandated rate hikes, traders said.
The Bovespa index of the 49 most-active stocks rose 4.33 percent to close at 9705 on heavy volume of 1.027 billion reais ($940 million).
"Volume hasn't been this high in a while. Telebras and all telecommunications stocks went wild on the rate adjustment," said one trader.
Telebras preferred shares jumped 5.99 percent to 122, with its common up 5.57 percent at 117.60.
Petrobras preferred shares gained 1.23 percent at 206.50, with its common stock up 5.59 percent at 170.

Of the blue chips, only state mining company CVRD fell. "People have lost interest in CVRD since the auction price was announced and won't get interested again until we're closer to the sell-off later this month," said one trader.
CVRD preferred shares fell 0.40 percent to close at 24.80, and its common stock was off 0.95 percent at 30.20.

The bolsa's Electrical Energy Index (IEE) rose 3.25 percent to close at 2616. The index, which includes the nine most liquid power stocks, was boosted by state-owned power company Eletrobras, whose preferred shares jumped 4.64 percent to 474.
